newsitem.title: USA: Texas Meridian in exploration joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Texas Meridian in exploration joint venture.

text.p: Texas Meridian Resources Corp said Monday it finalized a definitive agreement with The Louisiana Land and Exploration Co to form an exploration joint venture covering areas of the coastal transition zone of south Louisiana.

Under the terms of the agreement, Texas Meridian said it and LL&E have designated an area of mutual interest covering about 1,500 square miles in which they will jointly pursue the evaluation and drilling of new prospects, using 3-D seismic data and computer-aided-exploration technology.
The company and LL&E will each own a 50 percent working interest in joint projects within the area of mutual interest, Texas Meridian said.
The acquisition of oil and gas leases has already been completed for three projects under this alliance, with plans to conduct 3-D surveys in the near term, Texas Meridian said.
